description: Bun.serve with the experimental `http3: true` flag, no framework on top: QUIC on udp/8443 next to HTTP/1.1 on tcp/8443, with Alt-Svc advertised on the TCP responses. QUIC and HTTP/3 come from Bun itself (lsquic inside uWebSockets), not from a proxy in front. Routes and static handler are the plain bun entry's, so the delta against it is the transport. One process per core, all binding udp/8443 through reusePort.
